title: Browse additional object animation families
changes: Extend the indexed object animation view to word-task, layered and separately rooted title banks, with catalog-aware resource links and visible layered descriptor bytes.
Retain playback, loop, rate and manual graphics and palette selections when changing catalogs; support datasets with only the added families.
validation: Synthetic unit rom-data-viewer-obj-families-synthetic-vr3kmnd_ passed catalog navigation, title banks, settings and standalone-resource handling in Linux Chrome.

Protected EUR unit rom-data-viewer-obj-families-eur-8sz6o368 matched 22 additional banks, 637 lists, 2,539 objects, 44 sequences and 631 frames, then checked real manually paired pixels and title selections.
Linux Docker unit rom-data-viewer-obj-families-docker-tyqp9wuf matched Python output byte-for-byte; the validated ignored local page retained its previous data and inspector.
limitations: Layered animations are shown one layer at a time; graphics and palette pairing and timing are approximate. Other layered fields, native Windows and other preview families remain open.
